def.label: 30 mm autocannon
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.2's cycle (Q-49-3): a pull of three rounds every 10,000 ms; with the 120-round load (Q-49-22) that is forty pulls, about six and a half minutes of fire. Each round of a pull is its own draw, so what lands is a count and not all or nothing. The bands and the muzzle speed are 16b cut AE.2's: 1 km and 2 km, both past any sight on this map, and 1,050 m/s.
